a: Avoid per-item downstream calls; batch or join instead.
Cursors scale better than large OFFSET on big tables.
Async helps IO-bound workloads; CPU-bound needs processes/workers.
Pool size ≈ concurrent queries the DB can handle, not unlimited.
Enable gzip/brotli for JSON/text responses when CPU allows.
Hot keys can overload one cache shard; replicate or split keys.
Bulk APIs reduce chatty mobile/web clients.
Send read-only queries to replicas; keep writes on primary.
Set timeouts smaller than upstream so failures fail fast.
Profile CPU, allocations, and DB before optimizing guesses.
